about: Country cards for lives born in United Kingdom. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== United Kingdom (GB) ===================== Plan 5 student loans (England, from Aug 2023): 9% of income above £25,000, interest at RPI, written off after 40 years (GOV.UK, as summarised by Whitings LLP and uktax.tools). £25,000 in game money (÷ 0.633, PPP) ≈ 1.41 typical wages.

opts.do: sloanR = 0; sloanInc = { r: .09, th: 1.41, end: age + 40 }

en..x: Your student loan ({a}, Plan 5) is repaid through your payslip: 9% of everything you earn above £25,000 a year. Interest follows inflation (RPI), and whatever is left 40 years later is written off.
en..pay: Let payroll take care of it
en..pay.s: About {a} a year at your pay now; more as your pay rises.

zh..x: 你的学生贷款（{a}，第5类方案）从薪水里扣还：年收入超过£25,000的部分扣9%。利息跟着通胀（RPI）走，40年后剩下的全部免除。
zh..pay.s: 以现在的收入每年约{a}；收入越高扣越多。

zht..x: 你的學生貸款（{a}，第5類方案）從薪水裡扣還：年收入超過£25,000的部分扣9%。利息跟著通膨（RPI）走，40年後剩下的全部免除。
zht..pay.s: 以現在的收入每年約{a}；收入越高扣越多。

events.src: Lifetime ISA: open from 18 to 39, save up to £4,000 a year with a 25% government bonus (max £1,000); for a first home up to £450,000 or after 60, otherwise a 25% withdrawal charge (GOV.UK; MoneyHelper).

opts.do: yearly('lisa', { amt: a, until: 50, bonus: .25 }, { lock: 60 }, 'trk.lisa')

en..x: Open a Lifetime ISA before 40: save up to £4,000 a year and the government adds 25%. It can buy a first home costing £450,000 or less, or be spent after 60; take it out for anything else and 25% is charged.
en..lisa.s: About {a} a year; the government adds {b}.
en..isa.s: About {a} a year, tax-free, with no bonus and no lock.

zh..x: 40岁前可以开终身个人储蓄账户（Lifetime ISA）：每年最多存£4,000，政府再加25%。可以用来买£450,000以下的首套房，或在60岁后使用；其他用途提取要扣25%。
zh..isa.s: 每年约{a}，免税，没有奖励金也不锁定。

zht..x: 40歲前可以開終身個人儲蓄帳戶（Lifetime ISA）：每年最多存£4,000，政府再加25%。可以用來買£450,000以下的首套房，或在60歲後使用；其他用途提取要扣25%。
zht..isa.s: 每年約{a}，免稅，沒有獎勵金也不鎖定。

events.src: Workplace pension: automatic enrolment with a minimum of 8% of qualifying earnings, at least 3% from the employer (The Pensions Regulator); normal minimum pension age 57 from 2028 (HMRC).

en..x: You’ve been automatically enrolled in a workplace pension: at least 5% of your qualifying pay goes in (tax relief included) and your employer adds at least 3%. You can opt out and keep the 5% as pay.
en..stay.s: {a} a year from your pay; your employer adds {b}. Locked until 57.
en..more.s: {a} a year from your pay; your employer still adds {b}.
en..out.s: About {a} more take-home pay a year.

zh..x: 你被自动加入职场养老金：至少5%的合格薪资存进去（含税务减免），雇主至少再加3%。你可以退出，把5%留作薪水。
zh..stay.s: 每年从薪水扣{a}，雇主再加{b}。锁到57岁。
zh..more.s: 每年从薪水扣{a}，雇主仍加{b}。

zht..x: 你被自動加入職場退休金：至少5%的合格薪資存進去（含稅務減免），僱主至少再加3%。你可以退出，把5%留作薪水。
zht..stay.s: 每年從薪水扣{a}，僱主再加{b}。鎖到57歲。
zht..more.s: 每年從薪水扣{a}，僱主仍加{b}。

events.src: NHS waits: 7.41 million waiting pathways in August 2025, with 61% waiting under 18 weeks (NHS England RTT statistics, via Health Care and Protection). A private knee replacement at about £13,500 ≈ 0.76 of the game's typical wage: an ESTIMATE.

en..x: You need a knee replacement. The NHS will do it for free, but about 7.4 million cases were waiting in England in 2025, and almost 4 in 10 had waited more than 18 weeks. A private hospital charges around £12,000–15,000.
en..wait.s: Free, but months of pain first, and time off work. Happiness −4.

zh..x: 你需要换膝关节。NHS免费帮你做，但2025年英格兰约有740万个案例在排队，近四成等了18周以上。私立医院收费约£12,000–15,000。
zh..wait.s: 免费，但要先痛好几个月，还要请假。幸福感 −4。
zh..private.s: 约{a}{ins}。几周内就动手术。幸福感 +1。

zht..x: 你需要換膝關節。NHS免費幫你做，但2025年英格蘭約有740萬個案例在排隊，近四成等了18周以上。私立醫院收費約£12,000–15,000。
zht..wait.s: 免費，但要先痛好幾個月，還要請假。幸福感 −4。
zht..private.s: 約{a}{ins}。幾周內就動手術。幸福感 +1。

events.src: Shared Ownership: buy a 10–75% share with a mortgage and pay rent (usually up to 2.75–3% of the unsold share's value a year) to a housing association (GOV.UK Shared Ownership).

opts.ok: liq >= .12 * Sh || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.12 * Sh), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(Sh, { dp: .1, fee: .02, r: .03, n: 30, lk: 'trk.gb_shared', frac: 1 }); T('gb_soRent', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.gb_soRent') }); rec('gb_soRent', .0165 * P, 30)

en..x: With Shared Ownership you buy part of a home (10% to 75%) with a mortgage and pay rent to a housing association on the rest, usually up to 3% of its value a year. You can buy more later. A home near you costs {p}.
en..share.s: {d} up front and {m} a year on the mortgage, plus {r} a year in rent on the rest.

zh..x: 共有产权让你用房贷买下房子的一部分（10%到75%），其余部分付租金给住房协会，通常每年不超过那部分价值的3%。之后可以再买更多份额。你附近一间房子要{p}。
zh..share.s: 首付{d}，房贷每年{m}，其余部分每年租金{r}。

zht..x: 共有產權讓你用房貸買下房子的一部分（10%到75%），其餘部分付租金給住房協會，通常每年不超過那部分價值的3%。之後可以再買更多份額。你附近一間房子要{p}。
zht..share.s: 頭期款{d}，房貸每年{m}，其餘部分每年租金{r}。

events.src: Childcare in England: 30 hours a week of funded childcare in term time for working parents of children from 9 months, from September 2025 (Department for Education; Working Families). Costs of extra hours are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: T('gb_cc', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.daycare') }); rec('gb_cc', .1 * B, 4)
T('gb_cc', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.daycareF') }); rec('gb_cc', .03 * B, 4)

en..x: Since September 2025, working parents in England can get 30 hours a week of free childcare in term time, from when a child is 9 months old. Extra hours, meals and holidays you pay for yourselves.
en..both.s: Extras cost about {a} a year for 4 years.
en..part.s: About 40% less pay for 4 years (16 hours a week or more keeps the free hours). Happiness +2.
en..family.s: You help with their costs: about {a} a year.

zh..x: 从2025年9月起，英格兰的在职父母在孩子满9个月后，学期内每周可享30小时免费托儿。额外的时数、餐费和假期要自己付。
zh..part.s: 4年内工资少约40%（每周至少16小时才保得住免费时数）。幸福感 +2。
zh..family.s: 你帮忙负担他们的开销：每年约{a}。

zht..x: 從2025年9月起，英格蘭的在職父母在孩子滿9個月後，學期內每週可享30小時免費托育。額外的時數、餐費和假期要自己付。
zht..part.s: 4年內薪水少約40%（每週至少16小時才保得住免費時數）。幸福感 +2。
zht..family.s: 你幫忙負擔他們的開銷：每年約{a}。

events.src: National Insurance gaps: the full new State Pension is £230.25 a week in 2025/26 and needs 35 qualifying years; a voluntary Class 3 year costs £923 and adds about £342 a year (1/35 of the full rate) (Which?, 2025). In game money a year costs ≈ 0.052 and adds ≈ 0.019 a year; three missing years.

opts.do: pay(.156 * B); penScheme('gb_ni', 0, 0, .058 * B, 67); const t = trk.gb_ni; t.v -= .156 * B; t.paid = .156 * B

en..x: Your National Insurance record has three missing years from time abroad or out of work. The full new State Pension (£230.25 a week in 2025/26) needs 35 qualifying years. Each missing year costs £923 to fill and adds about £342 a year to your pension, for life.
en..fill.s: Pay {a} now for about {b} more pension a year from 67.

zh..x: 因为出国或没工作，你的国民保险记录少了三年。全额新国家养老金（2025/26年度每周£230.25）需要35个合格年。每补一年要£923，之后每年多领约£342，终身领取。
zh..fill.s: 现在付{a}，67岁起每年多领约{b}的养老金。

zht..x: 因為出國或沒工作，你的國民保險記錄少了三年。全額新國家退休金（2025/26年度每週£230.25）需要35個合格年。每補一年要£923，之後每年多領約£342，終身領取。
zht..fill.s: 現在付{a}，67歲起每年多領約{b}的退休金。

events.src: Premium Bonds: a 3.60% prize fund rate until April 2026, then 3.30% with odds of 23,000 to 1 per £1 bond; prizes tax-free (NS&I press release, Feb 2026). With UK inflation near 3.5%, about 0% in today's money; a cash ISA about 0.5%: ESTIMATES.

en..x: With Premium Bonds your savings are safe with NS&I, and instead of interest each £1 bond enters a monthly prize draw. The prize fund rate was 3.6% in 2025 and 3.3% from April 2026; prizes are tax-free, but most bonds win nothing in most months. You have {a} to put somewhere.
en..bonds.s: Move {a} in. Over the years, about the same as inflation.
en..cash.s: Move {a} in. About 0.5% a year after inflation.

zh..x: 有奖债券（Premium Bonds）由国家储蓄投资局担保，不付利息，而是每1英镑债券参加每月抽奖。2025年奖金池利率为3.6%，2026年4月起为3.3%；奖金免税，但大多数债券大多数月份什么都没抽中。你有{a}要找地方放。
zh..bonds.s: 放入{a}。长期下来大约和通胀持平。
zh..cash.s: 放入{a}。扣除通胀后每年约0.5%。

zht..x: 有獎債券（Premium Bonds）由國家儲蓄投資局擔保，不付利息，而是每1英鎊債券參加每月抽獎。2025年獎金池利率為3.6%，2026年4月起為3.3%；獎金免稅，但大多數債券大多數月份什麼都沒抽中。你有{a}要找地方放。
zht..bonds.s: 放入{a}。長期下來大約和通膨持平。
zht..cash.s: 放入{a}。扣除通膨後每年約0.5%。
